$comment: Accept/reject oracle for every *.adapter field in chiplet.schema.json (interposer.adapter, interconnect.adapter). The field is a REGISTRY ID resolved by the consuming ADK, never a filesystem path and never a deck file name. Canonical contract: the schema's pattern PLUS its .drc negative. Every implementation (adk_registry.validate_adapter_id, chiplet_kicad_plugin, chiplets-project-manager, chiplet-studio) runs THIS file in its parity test, so the proposition 'rejects everything the schema rejects' is exercised on one shared set. conformance/test_chiplet_schema.py proves the file against the schema itself. Add a case here, never in a consumer. Anchoring note: the schema uses (?![\s\S]) for true end-of-input in both Python re and ECMA-262; a Python implementation may use \Z, a C++ std::regex one uses regex_match with no end anchor; $ is WRONG in Python (matches before a trailing newline).
